errors.what: MANAGE_MERGE defaulted to 0.12, which is non-zero, so it overrode the `md = merge_dist if merge_dist > 0 else MERGE_FRAC*NEW_DIST` fallback — the 0.28 the code was written to produce under a comment reading 'ONE scale for create AND consolidate' had never once run. Creation used 0.35, consolidation 0.12.

PH_BOUNDS accumulated across epochs (appended inside build_stream, which runs once per epoch under DISK_STREAM), so by epoch 3 the phase index read 8 for a position whose phase was 2 — past the end of PHASE_SCHED. PHASED=1 would have failed in exactly the multi-epoch config it exists for.

`except Exception: model.train()` silently swallowed the learning-curve sampler's error, so the whole section printed nothing. Root cause: nbytes() reads BLEN, which is None until the final re-tokenization whenever TOK_ONLINE is set — nbytes is unusable mid-run.
The IS THE PARTITION INFORMATIVE section vanished silently when only one domain still held retrievable entries (memory had evicted everything else).

Adaptive encoder warmup stop condition `_sep <= _prev_sep*(1+eps)` is equally true of a flat and a FALLING curve, so a 69% collapse in signature separation (0.16 -> 0.05) was called convergence and training stopped at 501/2000.
probe_stability printed 'NO MORE THAN CHANCE' for two runs that each had exactly one domain — an experiment that never ran, reported as a negative result.
Shell quoting broke two test grids ('ambiguous redirect' from spaces in labels), losing arms of the sweep.
API Error: 529 Overloaded twice in a row; the user had to send 'Change defaults to have things on...' three times.

ab_no_world exited 1 with no data: WORLD_GROW defaults ON and its step hook dereferenced world_fwd.n() outside the `if WORLD_MODEL:` block, so WORLD_MODEL=0 died at the first MANAGE_EVERY. The one ablation that would say what the world model is worth had never run.

SIG_SPACE=tokens arm crashed: `ValueError: expected sequence of length 64 at dim 1 (got 0)`. The training loop translated the index correctly (`i if SIG_SPACE == 'tokens' else bpos`) but every EVAL site did tok_bs[s] unconditionally — silently reading the wrong window under token space, and only crashing at the tail.

memory.py:35 `if self.n_own > 1: cap = self.n_own * self.quota` silently overrode MEM_CAP=200000 to 8192 slots once MEM_PER_EXPERT defaulted ON — a 24x cut to the store that every memory number scales with.
The ablation table's `+mem` column matched a bare `MEMORY [0-9.]+`, so it printed the coherence FRACTION 0.50 for five arms and BITS/BYTE 2.618 for the sixth, in one unlabelled column.
The new coherence resampling (32 autoregressive generations per arm) blew the smoke gate past its 10-minute timeout — a gate broken one commit after being sped up.

RESUME crashed at the first domain merge after any resume: asm.born and asm.act were never saved, and _absorb reads s.born[a] with no default. Every resumed run would have died within DOM_MANAGE_EVERY steps — fatal on a 14-day run.

Optimizer moments are not restored on resume after growth: add_param_group during training gives the checkpoint more param groups than a freshly built optimizer, and remapping moments across a different flattening would silently attach them to the wrong tensors.
open_corpus globs `*` while fetch_big.py writes `_fetch_manifest.json` into the same directory — the manifest would have been spliced into the corpus and trained on as English.

The fetch GB split (20/8/10/1) was wrong: build_stream picks segments with random.choice(act), uniform over active domains and never weighted by corpus size, so a small corpus gets re-read ~100x rather than getting less attention.

The new cross-run-boundary holdout probe shipped pooled with no error bar — eng and py both printed 4.259 — immediately after fixing coherence for the same defect. Also Python's salted hash() would have redrawn the probe windows every process.

EXPERTS=1 AND FABRIC=1 makes the expert bank a silent no-op (the forward pass is an elif chain and FABRIC wins), which also means the smoke grid's no_experts arm tests nothing and passes because it is a no-op.
World model reports 'beats baseline -84.7% | latent std 0.07' against its own printed criterion that std ~0 = collapsed — the same collapse shape the signature encoder had.
